title: Autonomy Engineering Specialist - Integrated Technology
description:
**career area:**

technology, digital and data

**job description:**

**your work shapes the world at caterpillar inc.**

when you join caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. we are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. we don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

robotics is a key part of caterpillar's autonomy efforts. we are a small team with the opportunity to make a big impact. as caterpillar is an established company with thousands of products in mining and construction all around the world, the customer pull for autonomy is clear. we are looking for an engineering specialist to join our team of experts in developing cutting-edge autonomous and operator-assisted driving systems. as an engineer on the team, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and testing algorithms. you will also collaborate with other engineers and researchers to integrate your solutions into our software stack and hardware platform.

**what you will do:**

* solve challenging problems for mobile off-road machines.
* participate in design and development of high-quality software and algorithms to solve our customer needs.
  + document architecture specifications, software design, verification plans, test cases, operating procedures, and safety procedures.
* work with application teams to collect and analyze data on customer experience with robotic and manned platforms.
* use appropriate tools to debug, test and maintain software and assist in the verification and validation process.

**what you have:**

* **artificial intelligence/autonomy:**
  + have a working knowledge of mobile robotics for autonomy or advanced operator assist systems. this includes a working knowledge of computer vision, machine learning and deep learning techniques and familiarity with lidar, radar and cameras as sensors.
  + design, write, test and review autonomy and advanced operator assist software
  + experience in embodied ai
  + proven ability to work independently and within a team
* **software development life cycle & programming languages & application development tools:**
  + have extensive experience of the agile software development life cycle, the c++ and python programming languages, azure devops or jira for project management and work item tracking, standard software development tools (cmake, git, sonarqube, docker, googletest, artifactory) used in development of mobile robot software systems.
  + have a working knowledge of cloud compute and storage tools, aws ec2, s3, and batch
  + have experience with ros or caterpillar’s autonomous infrastructure software (ais), opencv, tensorflow/pytorch, and code development tools.
  + extensive experience participating in efforts to develop, integrate, or test complex autonomy systems that meet prioritized requirements and time frame constraints for autonomous machine programs focusing on machine safety and productivity.
  + ability to solve complex issues spanning multiple subsystems.
* **problem solving:**
  + have extensive experience in autonomy for mobile robotics with the following:
  + experience solving challenging problems in autonomy and operator assist systems
  + a passion for innovation and problem-solving
  + excellent communication and teamwork skills
  + strong mathematics skills
* **education requirements:** requires a degree or multiple degrees in engineering, computer science, robotics, or related field

**consideration for top candidates:**

* proven experience supporting product development for on-road/off-road software engineering projects.
* experience supporting platform level development projects and interfacing with internal development groups
* experience with core robotics planning level development projects
* experience with nvdia hardware preferred

**additional information:**

* this position requires the candidate to work full-time at the irving (dallas), tx office.
* relocation assistance is available for this position
* visa sponsorship is not available with this position.
* this position will require up to 10% travel

**summary pay range:**

$128,470.00 - $208,770.00

compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at caterpillar.

**benefits:**

subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. this is a summary list of benefits.

* medical, dental, and vision benefits\*
* paid time off plan (vacation, holidays, volunteer, etc.)\*
* 401(k) savings plans\*
* health savings account (hsa)\*
* flexible spending accounts (fsas)\*
* health lifestyle programs\*
* employee assistance program\*
* voluntary benefits and employee discounts\*
* career development\*
* incentive bonus\*
* disability benefits
* life insurance
* parental leave
* adoption benefits
* tuition reimbursement

* these benefits also apply to part-time employees

**posting dates:**

october 6, 2026 - october 18, 2026

any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.

caterpillar is an equal opportunity employer, including veterans and individuals with disabilities. qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
empower pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. as the nation's most advanced 503a compounding pharmacy and fda-registered 503b outsourcing facility, we're redefining what's possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. we're proud to be recognized as one of houston's fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in healthcare & medical on the inc. 5000 list for 2025.

our strength is built on four core values: people, quality, service, and innovation. guided by these principles, we've created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. from manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

at empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. it means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that's transforming healthcare at scale. we invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

if you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, empower pharmacy is the place for you. let's transform healthcare together.

**position summary**

the senior qa automation engineer serves as a senior technical authority responsible for advancing empower's enterprise test automation strategy across complex software systems supporting rapidly scaling 503a/503b operations, including manufacturing, order management, and compliance-critical applications. this role establishes scalable automation approaches, technical standards, and quality engineering practices that improve software reliability, release confidence, and organizational speed.

the position provides advanced technical leadership across the full automation lifecycle, including automation architecture, test strategy, framework design, ci/cd integration, risk-based testing, defect prevention, and continuous improvement. the senior qa automation engineer exercises substantial independent judgment in identifying systemic quality risks, evaluating complex technical tradeoffs, and recommending solutions that influence multiple applications and cross-functional teams.

operating in a highly regulated environment, this role serves as a key technical partner to engineering, product, qa, validation, and business stakeholders to ensure automated testing practices are scalable, reliable, traceable, and aligned with applicable computer system validation and data integrity requirements. the position also provides technical guidance and mentorship to qa engineers and analysts, strengthens organizational automation capabilities, and identifies emerging technologies and ai-enabled opportunities that improve testing effectiveness while maintaining accountable engineering judgment.

**responsibilities**

**test automation architecture and technical leadership**

* **automation strategy:** lead the development and evolution of scalable test automation strategies across multiple applications and technology environments. establish automation priorities based on business risk, technical complexity, release frequency, and organizational impact.
* **framework architecture:** design and evolve reusable automation frameworks, standards, and patterns supporting ui, api, integration, regression, and other automated testing needs. evaluate technical tradeoffs and establish approaches that improve maintainability, scalability, reliability, and long-term engineering efficiency.
* **technical standards:** define and promote automation engineering standards, coding practices, test design principles, and documentation requirements that improve consistency and quality across teams. review complex automation solutions and provide technical recommendations to strengthen overall testing practices.
* **ci/cd enablement:** partner with engineering and devops teams to embed automated testing into ci/cd pipelines and release processes. identify opportunities to improve test execution speed, environment reliability, test data management, and quality feedback loops across the software delivery lifecycle.

**quality & problem solving**

* **risk-based test strategy:** lead the assessment of complex system changes and determine appropriate automation and testing strategies based on business criticality, technical risk, regulatory requirements, integration dependencies, and potential customer or operational impact.
* **complex problem resolution:** investigate complex automation failures, systemic defects, production incidents, and recurring quality issues. apply advanced technical analysis to identify root causes, evaluate solution alternatives, and recommend sustainable corrective actions.
* **quality engineering:** influence a proactive quality engineering approach by identifying quality risks early in the development lifecycle and partnering with technical teams to improve testability, defect prevention, and release readiness.
* **continuous improvement:** lead initiatives that improve automation coverage, test reliability, framework maintainability, and engineering efficiency. identify systemic opportunities to reduce manual testing, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen the organization's overall quality maturity.

**cross-functional & enterprise influence**

* **strategic partnership:** serve as a senior technical advisor to engineering, product, qa, validation, and business stakeholders on automation capabilities, testing risks, quality tradeoffs, and release readiness.
* **technical influence:** lead cross-functional discussions involving complex testing challenges and competing priorities. influence technical decisions and quality strategies through expertise, data, risk analysis, and practical recommendations.
* **mentorship and capability building:** provide advanced technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to qa engineers, analysts, and other technical team members. share expertise, establish reusable practices, and strengthen organizational capability in automation engineering.
* **technology evaluation:** evaluate emerging testing technologies, ai-enabled capabilities, and automation tools to determine their potential value and appropriate use within empower's technology environment.

**regulated quality & compliance**

* **compliance strategy:** provide technical leadership for automation practices supporting regulated applications and ensure testing approaches maintain appropriate traceability, documentation, data integrity, and validation discipline.
* **validation partnership:** partner with validation and quality teams to translate regulatory and computer system validation requirements into practical, scalable automated testing approaches.
* **risk escalation:** independently identify and escalate significant technical and quality risks that could affect regulated operations, software reliability, business continuity, or compliance.

**knowledge and skills**

* advanced expertise designing and evolving scalable test automation frameworks for ui, api, integration, and regression testing using technologies such as selenium, cypress, playwright, or similar platforms.
* advanced proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language used for automation engineering, such as python, java, javascript, or typescript, including the ability to establish reusable automation patterns and engineering standards.
* advanced understanding of api testing, sql, test data management, service integrations, and complex software architectures.
* strong expertise integrating automated testing into ci/cd pipelines and software delivery workflows using tools such as jenkins, azure devops, gitlab ci, git, or comparable technologies.
* advanced ability to evaluate technical risk, diagnose complex automation and software failures, identify systemic patterns, and develop sustainable solutions.
* strong understanding of software architecture, sdlc practices, agile delivery, quality engineering principles, and strategies for improving software testability and defect prevention.
* ability to influence technical decisions and communicate complex quality risks, technical tradeoffs, and recommendations to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
* advanced ability to establish and improve automation standards, frameworks, and practices that support multiple applications, teams, or technology environments.
* working knowledge of computer system validation, 21 cfr part 11, data integrity, traceability, and documentation requirements applicable to regulated software environments.
* ability to evaluate and responsibly apply ai-enabled tools to improve test design, automation development, defect analysis, and engineering productivity while maintaining human review and accountable technical judgment.

**experience and qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and practical experience required.
* 6+ years of experience in qa automation, building and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks in a professional software environment, including demonstrated experience designing automation frameworks, standards, or reusable patterns — not solely writing individual test cases required.
* proven ability to design test strategies, troubleshoot automation failures, document test evidence, and deliver reliable testing outcomes across cross-functional stakeholder groups required.
* istqb certified tester foundation level (ctfl) required.
* experience testing within regulated, quality-controlled, or highly documented software environments (e.g., pharma, healthcare, life sciences) where computer system validation (csv), 21 cfr part 11, and traceability are important preferred.
* experience with performance or load testing tools (e.g., jmeter, k6) and exposure to cloud platforms (aws or azure) preferred.
* istqb advanced level – test automation engineering (ctal-tae), or equivalent test automation certification preferred.
* **a plus:** microsoft 365 certified: copilot and agent administration fundamentals.
* **a plus:** aws certified cloud practitioner or microsoft certified: azure fundamentals (az-900).

**key competencies:**

* customer focus: builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
* strategic ai: guides responsible ai adoption and adaptation.
* optimizes work processes: drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
* collaborates: partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
* resourcefulness: secures and deploys resources efficiently.
* manages complexity: simplifies and solves complex challenges.
* ensures accountability: delivers on commitments with integrity.
* situational adaptability: adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
* communicates effectively: tailors messages to diverse audiences.

**values:**

* people: empowering people defines who we are.
* quality: excellence in every product, every time.
* service: serving others is our highest purpose.
* innovation: advancing care through technology and discovery.

**employee benefits, health and wellness:**

we offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, iv therapy, and compounded medications. learn more: https://careers.empowerpharmacy.com/benefits/

**physical requirements:**

while performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. the employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
since 2012, we've grown to become one of the leading single-family rental companies and homebuilders in the country, recently recognized as a top employer by fortune and great place to work®. at amh, our goal is to simplify the experience of leasing a home through professional management and maintenance support, so our residents can focus on what really matters to them, wherever they are in life.

the **senior data engineer** is responsible for designing, building, and managing the data platform and tools to allow for the efficient processing and analysis of large data sets. develops and maintains scalable data pipelines, ensures data quality, and deploys machine learning models to production. collaborates with business teams to improve data models that feed business intelligence tools, increasing data accessibility and fostering data-driven decision-making across the organization. builds real-time and batch pipelines to handle large volumes of data efficiently. collaborates with cross-functional teams and translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.

**responsibilities:**

* design, develop, and maintain real-time or batch data pipelines to process and analyze large volumes of data. designs and develops programs and tools to support ingestion, curation, and provisioning of complex first party and third-party data to achieve analytics, reporting, and data science. design and develop advanced data products and intelligent api’s. monitors the system performance by performing regular tests, troubleshoots, and integrates new features.
* lead in analysis of data and the design the data architecture to support bi, ai/ml and data products.
* designs and implements data platform architecture to meet organization analytical requirements. ensures the solution designs address operational requirements such as scalability, maintainability, extensibility, flexibility, and integrity.
* provide technical leadership and mentorship to team members. leads peer development and code reviews with focus on test driven development and continuous integration and continuous development (cicd).

**requirements:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data science, management information systems, mathematics, physics, engineering, statistics, economics, and/or a related field required.
* master’s degree in computer science, information systems, data science, management information systems, mathematics, physics, engineering, statistics, economics, and/or a related field preferred.
* minimum of eight (8) years of experience as a data engineer with full-stack capabilities
* minimum of ten (10) years of experience in programming
* minimum of five (5) years in cloud technologies like azure, aws or google.
* strong sql knowledge
* experience in ml and ml pipeline a plus
* experience in real-time integration, developing intelligent apps and data products.
* proficiency in python and experience with ci/cd practices
* strong background in iaas platforms and infrastructure
* hands-on experience with databricks, spark, fabric, or similar technologies
* experience in agile methodologies
* hands-on experience in the design and development of data pipelines and data products
* experience in developing data ingestion, data processing, and analytical pipelines for big data, nosql, and data warehouse solutions.
* hands-on experience implementing data migration and data processing using azure services: adls, azure data factory, event hub, iot hub, azure stream analytics, azure analysis service, hdinsight, databricks azure data catalog, cosmo db, ml studio, ai/ml, etc.
* extensive experience in big data technologies such as apache spark and streaming technologies such as kafka, eventhub, etc.
* extensive experience in designing data applications in a cloud environment.
* intermediate experience in restful apis, messaging systems, and aws or microsoft azure.
* extensive experience in data architecture and data modeling
* expert in data analysis and data quality frameworks.
* knowledgeable with bi tools such as power bi and tableau.
* may occasionally work evenings and/or weekends.

compensation

the anticipated pay range/scale for this position is $121,116.00 to $151,395.00 annually. actual starting base pay within this range will depend on factors including geographic location, education, training, skills, and relevant experience.

additional compensation

this position is eligible to receive a discretionary annual bonus.

perks and benefits

employees have the opportunity to participate in medical, dental and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts and/or health savings accounts; dependent savings accounts; 401(k) with company matching contributions; employee stock purchase plan; and a tuition reimbursement program. the company provides 9 paid holidays per year, and, upon hire, new employees will accrue paid time off (pto) at a rate of 0.0577 hours of pto per hour worked, up to a maximum of 120 hours per year.

* agent2ui, a2a protocol

* python

title: Autonomy Engineer II
description:
**worker type**

regular

**job description**

**job description**

**summary**  
  
the **autonomy & machine learning engineer ii** will have the opportunity to interact with r&d group to develop a variety of innovative computer vision detection, classification, localization, and tracking solutions for defense and commercial applications. these development efforts will generally be small focused design teams which will require a senior machine learning engineer to use a range of skills and tools across traditional engineering, computer science, and mathematical disciplines including computer vision, machine learning, optimization, deep convolutional neural networks, and visual tracking. this position will work on a variety of stages of development including requirements definition, concept design, prototyping, detailed design, test and evaluation and validation and verification testing.

**position responsibilities**

  

* support development of computer vision and machine learning algorithms capable of detection, classifying, localizing, and tracking objects-of-interest from a group 1 uav using the existing gimballed camera payload
* write and test software to support the integration of machine learning algorithms into aircraft (such as autopilots, payloads, or other functional components) or other robotic systems.
* explore and visualize data to gain an understanding of it, then identifying differences in data distribution that could affect
* implement machine learning systems and validate designs through a series of purpose-designed experiments
* create objectives and develop models that help to achieve them, along with metrics to track their progress
* perform analysis tasks using aerovironment and industry developed tools
* managing available resources such as hardware, data, and personnel so that deadlines are met
* analyze the ml algorithms to solve a given problem and ranking them by their success probability
* performance when deploying the model in the real world; verify data quality, and/or ensure it via data cleaning
* analyze the errors of the model and designing strategies to overcome them
* study and transform data science prototypes; research and implement appropriate ml algorithms and tools
* select appropriate datasets and data representation methods; run machine learning tests and experiments
* works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of variety of factors. exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action
* other duties as assigned

**basic qualifications (required skills & experience)**

  

* bs in computer vision and machine learning is required or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience - with qualifications in any of the following fields: mathematics, optimization, computer science/engineering, electrical engineering, aerospace, or mechanical engineering
* minimum of 2 – 5 years' relevant experience
* familiarity with c/c++ and matlab required
* familiarity with office software and computer-based productivity tools
* demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex systems

**other matrixed skills include:**

  

* proficiency with a deep learning framework such as tensorflow or keras
* proficiency with python and basic libraries for machine learning such as scikit-learn and pandas
* expertise in visualizing and manipulating big datasets
* proficiency with opencv
* familiarity with linux
* ability to select hardware to run an ml model with the required latency
* computational statistics
* mathematical optimization
* data mining
* exploratory data analysis
* predictive analytics

**other qualifications & desired competencies)**

  

* works well within defined requirements to complete tasks under moderate supervision
* must be a team player and collaborate effectively
* excellent verbal and written skills
* has effective problem-solving, analytical and interpersonal skills
* able to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, where small teams share a broad variety of duties
* displays strong initiative and drive to accomplish goals and meet company objectives
* takes ownership and responsibility for current and past work products
* is committed to learning from mistakes and driven to improve and enhance performance of oneself, others, and the company

**physical demands**

  

* ability to work in an office and manufacturing environment (constant)
* required to sit and stand for long periods; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard (frequent)

**clearance level**

  
no clearance

the salary range for this role is:

$97,500 - $148,750

aerovironment considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the location, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

we also encourage you to review our company website at http://www.avinc.com to learn more about us.

principals only need apply. no agencies please.

**about av:**

role summary:  
software development engineers are expert problem-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems. in this role, engineers spend approximately 60–75% of their time coding, working hands-on with code, data, and modern tools (including ai-assisted development, cloud services, and automation frameworks) to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality technology solutions that drive business outcomes in the fintech sector. they collaborate with cross-functional teams – product managers, designers, data scientists, qa, operations, and compliance – to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, all while adhering to best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

* experience with angular, nodejs, spring, mysql, and linux preferred.

* experience in technologies/software systems or a directly related field (minimum two years).
* experience in developing and/or implementing web-based or mobile applications (minimum two years).
* experience in system design and architecture for product components.
* experience in debugging and troubleshooting software issues.
* experience in code review and applying coding standards.
* experience in test planning and execution for software features.
* experience in responding to support requests and deploying fixes.
* experience in using software developer tools for code creation and maintenance.
* experience building and testing enterprise-scale web services (minimum one year).
* experience working with a test automation framework, including or similar to testng, playwright, and selenium web driver.
* ability to work effectively across development, quality assurance (qa), automation testing, and production support functions, adapting to evolving project and business needs.
* experience working on client-facing project or technical teams (minimum one year).
* experience in integrating feedback into design and solution fixes.
* experience in mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**about solace**
----------------

healthcare in the u.s. is fundamentally broken. the system is so complex that 88% of u.s. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

we're a series c startup, founded in 2022 and backed by inspired capital, craft ventures, torch capital, menlo ventures, signalfire, and ivp. our u.s. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

solace isn't a place to coast. we're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. if you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. we’re intense, and we like it that way.

***read more in our bloomberg funding announcement*** ***here******.***

**about the role**
------------------

at solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. we are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats.

the solace data team is looking for a data scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. reporting directly to the vp of data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making.

in this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous a/b tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful.

**what you’ll do**
------------------

* **build predictive models:** develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality.
* **drive forecasting rigor:** own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. you will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy.
* **design & analyze experiments:** lead the design and analysis of a/b tests and causal inference studies. you will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes.
* **uncover deep insights:** apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. you will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions.
* **productionize solutions:** work closely with data engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure.
* **communicate complexity:** translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. you will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions.

### **what you bring**

* **statistical expertise:** you have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting).
* **python & ml proficiency:** you are fluent in python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, numpy). you write clean, reproducible code.
* **forecasting experience:** you have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., arima, prophet, exponential smoothing).
* **advanced sql:** you can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you.
* **preferred masters degree or phd:** data science, applied science, or related fields.
* **data privacy awareness:** you understand the importance of protecting patient data. you are familiar with best practices for handling phi and pii and ensuring privacy in your analysis.
* **startup dna:** you are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. you take ownership of problems and are willing to wear many hats to get the job done.

### **bonus points**

* **deployment experience:** experience using tools like docker, airflow, or mlflow to deploy and monitor models in production.
* **healthcare experience:** experience working with healthcare or insurance claims data is a plus.
* **nlp & unstructured data:** experience applying natural language processing (nlp) techniques to extract insights from unstructured text data.
* **marketplace matching:** experience designing matching algorithms or ranking systems for two-sided marketplaces.
* **dbt & engineering skills:** comfort reading or writing dbt models to understand the lineage of your data.

*applicants must be based in the united states.*

**up for the challenge?**

we look forward to meeting you.

**fraudulent recruitment advisory:** solace health will **never** request bank details or offer employment without an interview. all legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com. report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

compensation range: $160k - $200k

title: AI Technical Consultant
description:
**your journey at crowe starts here:**

at crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. with real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. we embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our dna across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. that’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as ai-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. join us at crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**job description:**

**responsibilities**

* engage in the exploration and evaluation of early-stage data, ensuring the integrity and applicability for model development.
* crowe technical developers are project team members responsible for executing tasks as part of the ai transformation team that is embedded with business experts in crowe’s ai team
* document findings and provide strategic recommendations to business stakeholders, outlining potential paths forward, technological capabilities, and relevant limitations.
* you demonstrate the viability of potential solutions and seek to disprove assumptions through data exploration, experimentation, and lightweight proof of concept buildout.
* actively engage in professional learning within the constantly evolving ai landscape, with an emphasis on the microsoft ecosystem
* engage with your team to derive realistic effort estimates, embracing the iterative nature of early-stage ai development.
* participate in ethical, risk, and security discussions to ensure all solutions meet crowe’s high standards.
* facilitate meetings with business stakeholders to refine project objectives and demonstrate preliminary results.
* ensure a seamless transition of validated concepts to the ai development team for full-scale implementation.
* actively contribute to the professional growth and development of your team members via code review and coaching.
* you support your team members' growth through pair programming, code review, and/or knowledge sharing.

**essential job functions**

**data collection & exploration**

* executes basic data ingestion and cleansing tasks, following prescribed methods.
* assists in initial data exploration to validate source quality and relevance for ai use cases.

**support ai model prototyping**

* helps senior team members test simple machine learning or ai scripts using existing frameworks or notebooks (e.g., python, r).
* logs issues or anomalies discovered during experiments; escalates them to more senior resources.

**documentation & version control**

* maintains technical documentation of data pipelines, experiment settings, and preliminary results.
* adheres to version control best practices (git or similar tools) for code and configuration changes.

**environment configuration**

* configures basic development environments or sandbox settings under direction (e.g., provisioning cloud resource templates in azure or aws).
* applies standard security and compliance settings, following firm guidelines.

**research & tool familiarization**

* learns core ai tools and services (e.g., microsoft azure ai components, relevant ml libraries).
* keeps notes on new data sets or environmental changes that may impact solution scalability.

**relevant technical skillsets & certifications**

* familiarity with scripting languages (python, r, etc.) or data query tools (sql).
* basic understanding of version control systems (git) and cloud fundamentals (azure).
* introductory credentials (e.g., microsoft certified: azure ai fundamentals) may be encouraged.

**required skills**

* minimum of 1-2 years of experience in software development, with a focus on microsoft technologies and ai solutions.
* proficiency in microsoft power platform, including power apps and power automate
* proficiency in .net, c#, sql, python and javascript
* you are comfortable executing assigned tasks when provided guidance by your technical lead and/or team members; you proactively request help when needed and collaborate effectively.
* knowledge of ai/ml frameworks and tools
* you can communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical or unfamiliar audiences, both written and verbal; you support the creation of client-facing deliverables and documentation.
* conduct thorough testing and debugging of applications to ensure they meet the required performance and quality standards.
* create and maintain technical documentation for developed solutions, including user guides, technical specifications, and process documentation.

**preferred skills**

* experience with azure services, particularly azure ai, machine learning, and cognitive services.
* certifications in microsoft technologies (e.g., azure ai engineer associate, power platform solution architect).
* hands-on experience with dynamics 365 and its integration with power platform.
* expertise in prompt engineering and familiarity with tools like enterprise chatgpt, microsoft copilot, and azure ai studio
* experience with devops practices and tools within the microsoft environment.
* previous experience in a professional services environment.
* you want to stay fresh in ai. you aren't afraid to take a stab at large language model papers before they become blog posts (even if you don't have experience in it quite yet) or try out the latest tools. you’re probably subscribed to several newsletters or podcasts about ai topics.
* background in business analysis, with a knack for translating business needs into technical requirements.
* familiarity with agile methodologies and tools.

title: Software Engineer
description:
position summary

we are seeking a talented and motivated **software engineer** to join our growing technology team. the software engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications and systems that support the organization's business operations and long-term technology strategy.

this is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical technology solutions, and working collaboratively with business and technology teams. the ideal candidate will bring strong technical skills, sound engineering judgment, and an understanding of how technology can be leveraged to improve workflows, automate manual processes, increase efficiency, and enhance the overall user experience.

the software engineer will play an important role in the continued modernization of our technology environment and will have the opportunity to contribute to both **new product development and the enhancement of existing systems**.

key responsibilities

**software development**

* design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications.
* write clean, scalable, maintainable, and well-documented code.
* develop new applications, features, apis, integrations, and internal tools.
* enhance and modernize existing applications and technology systems.
* participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and ongoing support.
* troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application and system issues.
* conduct code reviews and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.

**systems & architecture**

* work with the leadership team to develop and implement scalable application architectures.
* contribute to decisions regarding technology platforms, frameworks, databases, apis, and development tools.
* build systems designed for reliability, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* develop and maintain integrations between internal and third-party systems.
* help identify opportunities to eliminate redundant technology and simplify the organization's technology environment.

**automation & process improvement**

* partner with business teams to understand existing workflows and identify opportunities for technology-driven improvements.
* develop and collaborate on automation solutions that reduce manual work and improve speed, accuracy, and consistency.
* translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
* identify opportunities to leverage apis, workflow automation, ai, and other emerging technologies.
* measure the effectiveness of technology solutions and continuously improve them.

**security & data protection**

* follow secure software development practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* help protect company and clients' confidential information.
* develop applications with appropriate authentication, authorization, access controls, encryption, and logging.
* identify and address potential security vulnerabilities.
* follow organizational cybersecurity, privacy, data protection, and technology policies.
* maintain a strong awareness of the security implications associated with ai, third-party applications, apis, and cloud technologies.

**collaboration**

* work closely with the coo, technology team, business leaders, and end users to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* participate in project planning, technical design sessions, sprint planning, and other development activities.
* collaborate with other engineers to establish consistent development practices and standards.
* provide thoughtful recommendations regarding technology solutions and implementation approaches.

required qualifications

* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* **5+ years of professional software development experience** preferred.
* strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as **java, python, or similar**.
* experience developing web applications, apis, and software integrations.
* strong understanding of software development principles, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.
* experience working with relational and/or nosql databases.
* experience with git and modern software development workflows.
* understanding of restful apis and system integrations.
* strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team.

preferred qualifications

* experience with **cloud platforms such as aws, azure, or google cloud**.
* experience with **react, .net, or similar modern frameworks**.
* experience designing and developing apis and microservices.
* experience with ci/cd pipelines and devops practices.
* experience integrating third-party saas platforms and apis.
* experience with workflow automation and business-process optimization.
* familiarity with ai, machine learning, or integrating ai services into applications.
* experience developing applications in environments where **security, privacy, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance** are critical.
* **experience working within professional services, financial services, healthcare, legal technology, or other data-sensitive environments is a plus.**

ideal candidate

the ideal candidate is more than someone who can write code. we are looking for an engineer who:

* thinks critically and approaches problems from a solutions-oriented perspective.
* understands the **business problem behind the technology request**.
* is comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
* takes ownership of projects and follows them through to completion.
* is curious about emerging technologies and understands how to apply them responsibly.
* looks for opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve inefficient processes.
* has strong attention to detail and takes pride in producing reliable, high-quality work.
* communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
* is comfortable challenging existing processes and proposing better solutions.
* understands that security and confidentiality must be incorporated into technology decisions from the beginning—not added later.

what you'll do in this role

the software engineer will have the opportunity to:

* build technology that directly improves business operations.
* develop new internal applications and tools.
* modernize legacy systems and workflows.
* automate manual processes.
* create integrations between disparate systems.
* contribute to the organization's broader technology architecture.

title: AI Security Engineer (Remote in the U.S.)
description:
guidepoint security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. by taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, guidepoint enables some of the nation's top organizations, such as fortune 500 companies and u.s. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

**general description**

the guidepoint security north central region is seeking a skilled ai security engineer to join our growing ai security services team within the automation and ai practice. you will assist customers in the design, implementation, security, and operational management of generative ai security solutions — including ai governance assessments, llm and agent security testing, shadow ai discovery, agentic workflow development, and architecture reviews.

**about the north central ai security practice**

you will work closely with peers across multiple domains including appsec, cloud security, and identity and access management to deliver holistic and secure solutions adhering to industry best practices. this role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the continued growth of our ai security practice and its expanding service portfolio.

**roles and responsibilities:**

* **ai security architecture & assessment:** conduct secure configuration reviews and security assessments of enterprise ai platforms (e.g., anthropic claude enterprise, openai chatgpt enterprise, microsoft copilot) against established control domains — including identity and provisioning, network and access enforcement, data protection and retention, and audit and compliance — identifying vulnerabilities, attack surfaces, and gaps against industry frameworks (e.g., owasp llm top 10, mitre atlas)
* **threat modeling for ai systems:** lead threat modeling exercises specific to ai workloads, covering prompt injection, model inversion, data poisoning, supply chain risks, excessive agency, privilege escalation through tool chaining, and unauthorized cross-application data movement across saas, self-hosted, and local ai deployments
* **ai coding tool & development environment security:** assess ai coding tools and development environments — including claude code, openai codex, open code, cursor, and mcp servers — for sandbox isolation, plugin allowlisting, secrets access, network egress controls, and ci/cd pipeline security
* **secure ai integration guidance:** advise client teams on securely integrating saas ai services and apis (e.g., openai, azure openai, aws bedrock) into enterprise applications, including safe handling of credentials, outputs, and user data
* **data security & privacy controls:** evaluate and recommend controls for data ingestion pipelines, rag architectures, and vector databases to prevent unauthorized data exposure, leakage through model outputs, or non-compliant data processing — including zero data retention enforcement, sensitivity labeling, data classification, and encryption key management
* **shadow ai discovery:** conduct shadow ai discovery engagements to inventory unsanctioned ai tool usage and assess associated data exposure risks across client environments
* **security controls & guardrails evaluation:** evaluate security controls and guardrails across ai platforms, including identity and access management, dlp integration, conditional access policies, siem and logging configurations, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and ai-specific runtime protections
* **agentic workflow development:** design, build, and deploy ai agent workflows including use-case design, agent architecture, and integration with security tooling and automation platforms
* **security architecture reviews:** perform security architecture reviews for organizations deploying ai agents that connect to tools, data sources, or other agents via mcp or agentic frameworks, delivering reference architectures and recommendations
* **security documentation & deliverables:** develop and deliver engagement artifacts including secure configuration review reports, prioritized findings registers, ai security control matrices, reference architectures, risk assessments, control frameworks, and secure enablement roadmaps
* **strategic ai security roadmap:** contribute to the development of long-term ai security strategies for clients, including prioritized remediation roadmaps, capability maturity assessments, and investment recommendations
* **collaboration & stakeholder engagement:** serve as a trusted security advisor bridging business stakeholders, ai/ml engineers, it operations, and information security teams — conducting stakeholder interviews and facilitating knowledge transfer sessions covering ai platform administration, troubleshooting, and operational runbooks
* **ai threat landscape monitoring:** continuously track emerging ai security research, adversarial techniques, regulatory developments, and vendor security advisories (e.g., anthropic, openai, microsoft feature releases) to keep client guidance relevant and proactive

**required experience and education:**

* 3+ years of experience in security engineering with a significant focus on cloud security and/or application security
* hands-on experience implementing, managing, securing, and supporting agentic ai solutions within an enterprise context, including enterprise ai platforms such as anthropic claude (enterprise, desktop, cowork, code), openai (chatgpt enterprise, codex, api), or microsoft copilot
* familiarity with major cloud service provider ai-focused services such as aws bedrock, aws sagemaker, azure ai foundry, or google vertex
* solid understanding of generative ai concepts, large language models (llms), context engineering, agentic tool usage, and foundational ai/ml principles
* operational experience in the usage of agentic coding assistants such as claude code, open code, cursor, or codex
* understanding of ai-specific security challenges including prompt injection, data poisoning, supply chain security, model extraction attacks, excessive agency, and privilege escalation through tool chaining
* ability to produce professional client-facing deliverables including assessment reports, findings registers, control matrices, and reference architecture documentation
* strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
* embraces emerging technologies, including ai tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes

**preferred experience and education**

* certifications such as aws certified ai practitioner, aws certified machine learning engineer, azure ai engineer associate, or claude certified architect
* understanding or experience with model fine-tuning techniques
* experience with policy as code languages like cedar or rego and infrastructure as code (iac) tools like aws cloudformation, terraform, opentofu, or equivalent technologies
* experience designing and implementing agentic ai architectures that balance security and autonomy
* familiarity with mcp client/server architecture vs. agentic skills and the associated security risks of each
* experience with ai security tooling categories such as ai security posture management (aispm), ai runtime protection, or ai control plane platforms
* prior experience in a consulting, professional services, or managed services delivery model with direct client engagement

**travel requirements:**

* up to 10% travel

**physical requirements:**

* sedentary work
* substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day
* required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

**we use greenhouse software as our applicant tracking system and zoom scheduler for hr screen request scheduling. at times, your email may block our communication with you. please be sure to check your spam folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.**

**why guidepoint?**  
  
guidepoint security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on information security. since its inception in 2011, guidepoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company's success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. at guidepoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

this is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.  
  
**some added perks….**

* remote workforce primarily (u.s. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for federal positions)
* group medical insurance options: zero deductible ppo plan (guidepoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or high deductible health plan with hsa (guidepoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). if you choose the high deductible / hsa plan, gps will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per ee annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
* group dental insurance: guidepoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans
* 12 corporate holidays and a flexible time off (fto) program
* healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance
* eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment
* pet benefit option

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
position overview

the solutions engineer is a rare, high-impact role for technologists who are equally energized by solving hard business problems and building the systems that fix them. sitting within bridgeway’s advanced technologies team, this individual goes deep with our operational business units to understand real, complex challenges, then comes back and builds the solutions from the ground up.

this isn’t a ticket-taking developer role or a requirements-gathering analyst role; it’s a full-ownership position that spans the entire solution lifecycle. you’ll design architectures, write production code, and ship working software directly into operations. ai-assisted development (including claude code) is a first-class tool here, not an afterthought, and this role sits at the center of bridgeway’s broader ai transformation strategy.

key responsibilities

business engagement & requirements

* embed directly with operations, finance, billing, collections, and other business units to uncover inefficiencies, automation opportunities, and high-value technology gaps
* run structured discovery to extract, document, and sharpen requirements, separating signal from noise and turning ambiguous asks into buildable specs
* convert messy, real-world business problems into precise solution briefs: tightly scoped, measurable, and ready to build against
* challenge assumptions and probe for root causes rather than accepting surface-level problem statements

solution design

* architect end-to-end solutions spanning process, data pipelines, system integrations, and application layers, always choosing the right tool for the job rather than the familiar one
* produce clean solution architecture documentation: data flows, api contracts, system interaction diagrams, and technical specs that others can build on
* define and document kpis and success metrics for every solution; establish baseline measurements and post-deployment tracking plans
* support process and organizational design work when solutions require workflow redesign or role realignment

development & delivery

* write production-ready code for internal tools, intelligent automations, system integrations, and ai-powered workflows, with a high bar for quality and maintainability
* use claude code and ai-assisted development as a force multiplier: shipping faster, thinking bigger, and continuously raising what’s possible for a team your size
* design and build integrations between core operational and enterprise platforms, billing systems, and external apis, creating connected systems that eliminate manual handoffs
* conduct unit testing, user acceptance testing coordination, and quality validation prior to deployment
* manage deployment activities, post-launch monitoring, and iterative improvements

stakeholder communication & collaboration

* maintain clear, proactive communication with business sponsors throughout the project lifecycle
* prepare solution documentation, user guides, and training materials as needed
* present solution designs and status updates to leadership in plain business language, not technical jargon
* work collaboratively within an agile/product-owner model, prioritizing, iterating, and shipping incrementally

ai & continuous improvement

* identify and build ai-powered capabilities into solutions, spanning classification and prediction models, generative ai workflows, and autonomous agentic processes
* stay on the cutting edge of ai tooling, llm capabilities, agentic frameworks, and developer toolchains, and actively bring what you learn back into bridgeway’s stack
* contribute to the company-wide ai adoption program through knowledge sharing, documentation, and peer enablement

qualifications

required

* 3–7 years of experience in a solutions engineering, business systems, or software development role
* demonstrated ability to independently gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver working software without heavy supervision
* proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (python strongly preferred; javascript, sql also valued)
* strong analytical skills with experience defining kpis, building data models, and interpreting operational data
* excellent communication skills, equally comfortable presenting to a vp or pairing with a frontline operator
* familiarity with api integration patterns (rest), relational databases, and data pipeline concepts
* experience working in or with agile / product-oriented delivery teams

preferred

* active hands-on experience with ai-assisted development tools: claude code, github copilot, cursor, or similar; comfort with llm apis and prompt engineering is a strong plus
* familiarity with rpa tooling (power automate, uipath) and/or workflow automation platforms
* experience with process mapping methodologies (l1–l3 process documentation)
* background in or exposure to organizational design and change management

what success looks like

in the first 90 days, the solutions engineer will have completed at least one full solution cycle, from stakeholder discovery through deployment, and will have established productive working relationships across the business units they support.

at 6 months, they will be operating as a trusted partner to multiple departments, managing a pipeline of active solutions, and demonstrating measurable operational impact through the work they’ve shipped.

at 12 months, they will be recognized internally as a subject-matter expert on how bridgeway builds technology solutions, and will be actively advancing the company’s ai adoption roadmap through their delivery work.

core competencies

business acumen understands freight brokerage operations and connects technology to business outcomes technical depth can design and build solutions end-to-end, not just document requirements or review others’ code

communication

translates complexity clearly, speaking both

business and technical fluently ownership mindset drives solutions from idea to impact without waiting to be directed; holds themselves accountable for outcomes

structured problem-solving

breaks complex problems into solvable

components; designs before building ai curiosity proactively incorporates ai tools into workflow; comfortable experimenting with emerging capabilities

about bridgeway

bridgeway is a freight brokerage company in the middle of a genuine technology transformation, and not one that’s been announced and forgotten. it is actively reshaping how we operate. our advanced technologies team is building the ai tools, intelligent automations, and connected systems that will define how bridgeway competes over the next decade.

if you want to do consequential technical work with real operational impact, in an environment that takes ai seriously and gives you the autonomy to build things that matter, this is that role.

backed by greylock and y combinator, fully remote since 2018.

this is a high-autonomy role for engineers who are energized by ambiguity, take genuine ownership of their work, and bring a strong point of view on how to build things well, without sacrificing speed or pragmatism. ai isn't a nice-to-have here — it's central to how we work. we expect our engineers to be active practitioners of ai-first development: fluent with the latest agentic coding tools, curious about what's emerging, and constantly pushing the boundary of what's possible with ai in their day-to-day craft. if you're the kind of engineer who's already experimenting with new models and tooling before anyone asks you to, you'll feel at home here.

as a senior engineer at postscript, you’ll no longer be only writing code but orchestrating it.

**this position is fully remote and can be based in the us or canada.**

**what you'll do**
------------------

* take deep ownership of systems and product areas on your team, and become the go-to technical expert for what you own
* independently investigate, design, and execute solutions across distributed systems with a high degree of ambiguity
* architect, build, and maintain highly available, scalable rest apis and backend services for internal and external use
* drive system decoupling, modularization, and technical debt reduction.. improve long-term maintainability without blocking near-term delivery
* build agentically as your default: leveraging concurrent autonomous agent workflows, owning the output, and keeping a steady queue of aligned work moving
* stay at the forefront of emerging ai tooling and practices, bringing new techniques back to the team and helping raise the floor for how postscript engineers work
* contribute to how we think about integrating ai into our systems and workflows. that means not just using ai tools, but helping shape where and how ai creates leverage across the engineering org
* collaborate cross-functionally with product, data, and go-to-market teams by communicating clearly and proactively in an async-first environment
* identify and eliminate single points of failure, improving system resilience and knowledge redundancy across your team
* improve how engineering gets done: bring better tools, fix workflow friction, build internal utilities when the leverage compounds

**what we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 6+ years of experience building large-scale data-intensive backend systems and apis
* you are an active, daily user of ai coding tools and are using them to maximize your output — claude code, codex, cursor, copilot, or equivalent — and can speak concretely to how they've changed your output and your workflow
* some or all of these languages: python, go, rust, react, and typescript
* you follow the ai tooling landscape closely: new model releases, emerging agentic workflows, and evolving best practices aren't things you catch up on eventually.
* you think critically about ai output and you know where it accelerates you, where it introduces risk, and how to verify what it produces
* you are able to context switch quickly across concurrent workstreams
* experience working on both 0-to-1 initiatives and complex existing systems, and knowing how to balance building new things with improving what's there
* you have working knowledge of event-driven distributed systems, kafka, and familiarity with distributed data processing technologies (flink/spark/etc)
* experience growing systems under production customer load, ideally from early days to the multi-terabyte stage
* experience building and designing high-scale systems aws with a broad variety of database technologies (rdbms, olap, nosql, etc.)
* you know how to intelligently model relational data and design index strategies. you write performant sql for transactional and analytical workloads
* experience with infrastructure as code (eg, terraform). you are comfortable evaluating and applying your infra changes.
* familiarity building and observing applications on aws & kubernetes, ideally with datadog, signoz, or comparable observability tooling
* clear, direct communication. cross-functional partners and async teams can count on you to surface information proactively
* strong instincts for technical tradeoffs informed by both engineering best practices and business priorities

**what you'll love about us**
-----------------------------

* salary range of usd $175,000–$205,000 base plus significant equity (we do not have geo-based salaries)
* high growth startup — plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career
* work from home (or wherever in us / canada)
* fun — we're passionate and enjoy what we do
* competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
* flexible paid time off
* health, dental, vision insurance

*for information about how we use your personal data, please see our u.s. job applicant* *privacy notice*

*you are welcome here. postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.*

title: Software Engineer (L2)
description:

at twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. we deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. as we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. your career at twilio is in your hands.  
.

also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.  
.

join the team as twilio’s next software engineer, twilio flex.

* experience with container technologies - docker/kubernetes.

* ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organization.
* experience with contact center and customer engagement solutions.

**location**

this role will be remote, and based in india - karnataka, tamil nadu, telangana state, maharashtra and new delhi.

**travel**

we prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. for this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

working at twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. offerings vary by location.

we like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. that's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call twilio magic. additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

so, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! if this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
* sunnyvale, ca, united states
* not remote
* engineering
* job218889

  

### **company description**

it started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **intuitive**. as a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da vinci surgical system** and **ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

we’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

the problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. the work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

if you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **job description**

**t**he ai engineering group within intuitive surgical has an immediate opening in sunnyvale, ca for a **senior** **machine learning engineer** with focus on computer vision, deep learning, generative ai and robotics, contributing to new technology development for next-generation robot-assisted surgery platforms. this role is an exciting opportunity to join a newly formed team and contribute to its growth and it will give you an opportunity to test your knowledge in a challenging problem-solving environment.

the successful candidate must excel in a high-energy, focused, small-team environment, be able to initiate and drive new research directions, and have a commitment to high research quality. a strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required.

**primary function of position**

* lead the research, design, and implementation of ai algorithms for computer vision (image and video analysis), multimodal data, and action models
* contribute to surgical ai and robotics pipelines; integrate, test, and evaluate accuracy bottlenecks of vision action (va), and vision language action (vla) models
* lead development of effective techniques and infrastructure, from the initial idea to the running prototype and product.
* contribute to research projects that develop a variety of algorithms and systems in computer vision, robotics, and multi-modal data fusion.
* advance the state-of-the-art in the field, including generating patents and publications.
* develop validation methods, datasets, pipelines, and evaluation metrics to show scalability to large clinical datasets.
* participate in integration of new ml/cv algorithms into existing and future robotic platforms.
* collaborate with users and clinical advisors to iterate prototype designs based on feedback and performance.
* develop new technologies and digital products to improve surgeon and team performance on robotic surgery platforms.
* support academic collaborations in related fields.

### **qualifications**

**required education, skills & experience**

* master's degree with minimum of 6 years industry experience developing computer vision and machine learning applications; or phd in computer science, electrical and computer engineering or related field and minimum of 3 years of experience
* strong understanding and experience in building effective learning systems (data collection, training, evaluation, and making iterative improvements).
* strong publication track record in conferences like cvpr, iccv, miccai, etc.
* strong hands-on experience with at least one of the mainstream deep learning frameworks such as tensorflow or pytorch.
* strong hands-on experience with python (proficiency), c/c++ (proficiency), shell scripting
* familiarity with control systems, robotics, kinematics, and dynamics.
* strong engineering practices, debugging/profiling skills, familiarity with multi-threaded programming.
* strong hands-on experience with gpu accelerated algorithms and implementations.
* strong hands-on experience with state-of-the-art ai models, vfms, or vision action models.
* excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
* interested in early phases of product exploration and iteration based on incomplete requirements.
* solid understanding of computer vision, machine learning, generative models, and deep learning.
* experience with visualization tools is a plus.
* self-starter and able to work in a collaborative and results-oriented environment.
* ability to travel domestically and internationally (5-15%)
* able to view live and recorded surgical procedures.

### **additional information**

**qualifications**

**required**

* strong hands-on experience with the tools and practices used by the role.

* experience testing, documenting, and supporting production solutions.

* experience using ai-assisted development tools and validating ai-generated work.

* experience building data products or curated data layers using databricks medallion architecture.

* experience with observability, data quality tooling, performance tuning, and cost optimization for cloud data workloads.
